signals.summary: Enphase laid off about 500 workers, 17% of its global workforce including contractors, per an SEC filing.
Earlier round of cuts removed 10% of the workforce, cited regulatory changes and weak solar demand.
Company reported nearly $1.8 billion in cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities at the end of September.
Quarterly profit fell to $45 million from nearly $114 million a year earlier, with European demand slumping.
Enphase reported US$1.47 billion in revenue for fiscal 2025.
